records.scope: Entire javap display in consecutive untruncated slices; declarations, all methods and static initializer; no archived execution.
records.observation: Static mutable global settings, VERSION_INFO 1.0.2.0. initSetupFile explicitly composes user.home + file.separator + .jumpshot4.conf and prints it; path initially null, no implicit initialization in read/write. Constructor only Object init. initStaticClasses separately propagates font, arrow head, event width, line/event/preview-event hit tolerance, State/PreviewState/SummaryState borders, preview display/min-category-height, Shadow insets/log base, NestingStacks initial/reduction heights and SummaryArrow log base; read/write do not call it themselves. writeToSetupFile first asks Dialogs.confirm; false returns before building Properties. PreferenceFrame already applied panel parameters BEFORE calling this, so cancelling file save does not roll back that update. Writes every declared preference including ACTIVE_REFRESH plus version, primitive String.valueOf, Alias/StateBorder object String.valueOf, two raw String values (null unsafe in Properties). Opens FileOutputStream at current path directly, Properties.store then close; no temporary file/atomic rename/backup/finally. IOException in opening/store/close prints stack and exits 1; runtime exceptions unhandled. On success prints toInOutString. readFromSetupFile loads Properties, closes and marks loaded; FileNotFoundException (not necessarily absence) announces first use and calls writeToSetupFile using CURRENT static settings, not a reset; cancellation allowed and empty Properties retained, no reread. Other IOException exits 1; no finally or runtime catch. Loaded file version missing/mismatch only warns, still applies fields. Each present key assigned sequentially, absent key preserves CURRENT value; no reset/transaction/rollback. Short.parseShort/Integer.parseInt/Float.parseFloat with no extra range/finite/positivity checks, NumberFormatException propagates after previous assignments. Boolean exact case-insensitive true or yes only, no explicit trim; other present strings false. Alias parsers receive only nonnull properties, unknown values fallback as Const receipt; border parse delegated; preview display raw string. ACTIVE_REFRESH is stored and printed but entirely OMITTED from readFromSetupFile, retaining current value (initially false), so saved true is not restored through this method. read returns after printing without propagating static rendering settings. toInOutString assembles all preferences, no version/path, newline each, reports current state not persisted reread verification. main initSetupFile then unguarded args[0].trim, exact lowercase write/read independent checks; no args throws, unknown mode only initializes path, no initStaticClasses. Static defaults: label SLOG-2; initial level4; auto windows/root visible true; screen ratio .5; scroll .01; active refresh false; black/default antialias; state/nesting .9/.8; min row/drag4; click radius3; instant zoom true; State color-raised border; arrow head10x6/event8; preview CumulativeExclusionRatio/color-XOR border/insets3x0/legend2/logbase5; search length20/frame3/on-top false; histogram zero true; summary color-raised/logbase5; both legend orders true. No own constraints protect downstream logarithm/size calculations from parsed values. Dialog behavior and panel field conversion remain separate caller/callee evidence; no setup file actually written or GUI executed.
